The white exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that complements any setting.

Inside, you'll find a spacious cabin with front bucket seats and cloth trim designed for comfort during your commute or longer journeys. The power driver seat adjusts to your preferred position, while the rear seat center armrest and split folding configuration provide flexibility for passengers or cargo. Climate control via air conditioning and rear window defroster ensures comfort throughout the year.

Safety is integrated into every aspect of this vehicle. Blind Spot Warning helps you stay aware of traffic around you, while auto high-beam headlights and rear parking sensors support confident driving in various conditions. The comprehensive airbag system, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability control work together to provide robust protection during your travels.

Technology keeps you connected and entertained. NissanConnect Services Powered by SiriusXM provides subscription-based capabilities, while Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration on the audio system allows seamless smartphone connectivity. The Wi-Fi hotspot feature turns your vehicle into a mobile hotspot for compatible devices. SiriusXM radio access expands your entertainment options beyond traditional AM/FM broadcasts.

Practical features enhance your daily experience. Speed-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions, variably intermittent wipers offer customizable operation, and fully automatic headlights activate as needed. The trip computer displays useful driving data, while the tachometer provides engine performance feedback. Illuminated entry and front reading lights improve visibility when you need it.

This 2025 Nissan Altima represents a solid choice for drivers who value reliability, efficiency, and modern technology in a well-appointed sedan. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand how this vehicle can serve your driving needs.

The Altima SL is powered by a **2.5L 4-cylinder engine** paired with Nissan's smooth **Xtronic CVT automatic transmission**. Depending on drivetrain configuration, the engine produces up to **188 horsepower and 180 lb-ft of torque** in FWD models, while AWD models produce 182 horsepower and 178 lb-ft of torque.

The Altima is also designed with efficiency in mind. FWD SL models are rated at **27 city / 37 highway MPG**, while AWD models are rated at **25 city / 34 highway MPG**.

The spacious cabin provides seating for five, while the 60/40-split folding rear seatback adds versatility when carrying larger items.

Technology is a major highlight of the SL. The Altima features a **12.3-inch infotainment display**, **wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto**, Bluetooth connectivity, and a premium **Bose 9-speaker audio system**. The SL also offers convenient connectivity and entertainment features designed to make everyday driving more enjoyable.

SAFETY & DRIVER ASSISTANCE

The Altima includes a comprehensive suite of driver-assistance technology, including **Blind Spot Warning, Lane Departure Warning, and Rear Cross Traffic Alert**. These features provide additional awareness during highway driving, lane changes, parking, and reversing.

Under the long aluminum hood sits Mercedes-Benz's 4.7-liter Twin-Turbocharged DOHC 32-valve V8 enginefeaturing direct fuel injection and multispark ignition. This mechanical core produces 402 horsepower at 5,000 RPM and 443 lb-ft of torque available early across a broad powerband from 1,600 to 4,750 RPM. Power is managed through a 7-speed 7G-TRONIC automatic transmission with steering-wheel-mounted aluminum paddle shifters. Drive torque is routed to the rear wheels via standard Rear-Wheel Drive (RWD) or through the optional 4MATIC permanent all-wheel-drive system. Supported by an AIRMATIC semi-active air suspension with adaptive damping, electromechanical direct-steer system, and 4-wheel ventilated disc brakes with ABS, the 4,158-lb CLS 550 RWD accelerates from 0 to 60 MPH in 4.9 seconds (4.3 to 4.5 seconds in independent testing) with an electronically limited top track speed of 130 MPH.

Car and Driver+ 1

On the exterior, the 2012 CLS 550 debuts a bold front design inspired by the SLS AMG super sports car, featuring a prominent single-slat grille, muscular rear wheel arches, and frameless door glass. It is notably the world's first passenger vehicle to offer full active LED headlights (with 71 individual LEDs across both assemblies) paired with Adaptive Highbeam Assist. Functional exterior features include dynamic LED taillights, power glass sunroof, power-folding heated side mirrors with memory, rain-sensing wipers, dynamic rear spoiler options, and dual trapezoidal exhaust tailpipes. The vehicle maintains an aggressive, low-slung stance rolling on 18-inch 5-spoke alloy wheelswrapped in staggered performance tires (with 19-inch AMG multi-spoke wheels widely optioned).

Inside, the driver-centric 2+2 cockpit welcomes up to four occupants into an executive luxury sanctuary draped in leather seating upholstery paired with Burl Walnut, Black Ash, or High-Gloss Brown Eucalyptus wood trim inlays. The interior features 14-way power heated front seats with 3-position memory and power lumbar support, an analog dash clock, a leather-wrapped multifunction steering wheel, Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control, ambient interior lighting, proximity KEYLESS-GO , and a fixed center console spanning the entire cabin length to create distinct rear bucket seats. Digital connectivity centers around the COMAND infotainment system featuring a 7.0-inch central color display screen. System features include 3D Navigation, Bluetooth phone and audio streaming, dynamic Voice Control, SiriusXM , 10GB Music Register, auxiliary/USB media interfaces, and a studio-quality 14-speaker 610-watt Harman Kardon Logic 7 Surround Sound System.

Practicality and spatial utility remain balanced within its sleek 113.2-inch wheelbase footprint. Opening the remote power trunk lid reveals 15.3 cubic feet of cargo trunk space, easily accommodating full-size luggage sets, executive golf bags, or daily supplies.

Backed by a 21.1-gallon fuel tank, the 4.7L Twin-Turbo V8 achieves an EPA-estimated 17 MPG city and 25 MPG highway (20 MPG combined) for RWD models (16/25 MPG for 4MATIC models). Safety features earn high marks, coming standard with ATTENTION ASSIST driver drowsiness monitor, PRE-SAFE predictive occupant protection system, Electronic Stability Program (ESP ), Brake Assist (BAS ), Tire Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS), dynamic Rearview Camera, available Driver Assistance Package (DISTRONIC PLUS adaptive cruise control, Active Blind Spot Assist, Active Lane Keeping Assist), and a comprehensive multi-stage 10-airbag protection canopy network including dual front airbags, front and rear seat-mounted side-impact airbags, driver knee airbag, and pelvic airbags to guarantee absolute driving confidence.

This 2024 Chevrolet Malibu LT 1LT delivers the practical performance and refined comfort you need for your daily commute and weekend travels.

- 1.5L turbo DOHC 4-cylinder engine with Variable Valve Timing and excellent fuel economy
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system with premium audio
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto capability
- Wi-Fi Hotspot capable
- SiriusXM satellite radio with AM/FM reception
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Heated driver and front passenger seats with power adjustments
- 8-way power driver seat with lumbar control
- Rear view parking camera
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control for confident handling

Climate control receives thoughtful attention with front dual zone automatic temperature management and rear window defroster, ensuring passenger comfort regardless of weather conditions. The power-adjustable steering column and telescoping steering wheel accommodate drivers of varying heights, while remote keyless entry and an illuminated entry system provide secure, convenient vehicle access.

Safety technology rounds out the Malibu's standard features with a comprehensive airbag array, electronic stability control, four-wheel antilock disc brakes, and a rear view parking camera to assist with backing maneuvers. The vehicle also includes OnStar emergency communication services and Chevrolet connected services capability for added peace of mind.

This Malibu LT 1LT offers the dependable transportation and modern amenities expected from a midsize sedan, backed by thoughtful engineering and genuine utility for today's driver.
